{{Quote|I am Asha; sister of Kneesaa; daughter of the great Chief Chirpa.|Asha|<ref name="Asha (episode)" />}}
'''Asha''', known to the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] as the '''Red Ghost''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] warrior who was part of a [[Kintaka clan/Legends|family]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. She was the daughter of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] and [[Ra-Lee/Legends|Ra-Lee]] and the older sister of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]]. Believed [[Death/Legends|dead]] after a [[hanadak]] attacked her and killed her mother, Asha survived with a clan of [[Korrina/Legends|korrinas]]. Eventually, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] and his friends saw her and told Kneesaa, and the sisters were reunited.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ewoks. We are Ewoks, remember?''"<br />"''I&hellip;remember.|Princess Kneesaa and Asha|<ref name="Asha (episode)" />}}
[[File:Chirpa_family.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ra-Lee, Kneesaa, and Asha]]
Asha was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who grew up in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] with her [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Ra-Lee/Legends|Ra-Lee]]; father, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]]; and younger sister, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]]. She was about six snows older than Kneesaa. One day when Asha was still a child, she was playing by the river when a [[hanadak]] attacked her. Her mother told Kneesaa to run for help while she tried to save her oldest daughter;<ref name="The Red Ghost" /> however, Ra-Lee [[Death/Legends|died]] and Asha disappeared, leaving behind only traces of [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. After an unsuccessful extended search of the area, her family gave her up for dead. Asha was found by a clan of [[Korrina/Legends|korrinas]], who accepted her and raised her as one of their own.<ref name="Asha (episode)" />

Asha spent her early adulthood tracking down [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] fur traders who called her the Red Ghost. Many years later, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] and his friends were in the forest when they saw a [[maramu]] stag caught in a net. When they went to free it, Asha and one of the korrinas appeared to defend the stag and the frightened friends fled. Wicket told Kneesaa about the encounter and she began to cry, reminded of her sister. After taking out Asha's ripped hood and telling her friend what had happened, Kneesaa had hope that the red-furred warrior was Asha. Wicket and Kneesaa went looking and eventually found her.<ref name="Asha (episode)" />

Asha agreed to return to her old home after Wicket and Kneesaa helped stop the Duloks. The Ewoks freed trapped animals from their cages and Asha defeated the Duloks. She then returned to Bright Tree Village with her sister.<ref name="Asha (episode)" />

==Personality and traits==
Asha had [[Color/Legends|red]] fur<ref name="The Red Ghost" /> like her mother.<ref name="Asha (episode)" /> She was named after a [[Asha (legend)|fierce huntress]] in the Ewoks' mythology.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> When Asha was reunited with her sister, she spoke with hesitation, not having much call to speak during her time with the korrina pack.<ref name="Asha (episode)" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Had we done a third season, I'm sure we would have done a few more stories ''[&hellip;]'' with Asha, Kneesaa's sister. We got many letters asking whatever happened to her. We did build her up as a major character and in the second season, we didn't do much with her.|''Ewoks'' story editor Paul Dini in 1988|<ref name="Starlog">{{Starlog|Yearbook Vol. 3|Saturday Morning "Star Wars"|Saturday Morning 'Star Wars'}}</ref>}}
[[File:Asha_hug_kneesaa.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Asha reunited with her sister, Kneesaa.]]
Asha was created by [[Paul Dini]] for [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']],<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> where she was voiced by [[Paulina Gillis]].<ref name="Asha (episode)" /> Many fans sent letters asking about Asha, leading Dini to wish the ''Ewoks'' team had told more stories about her after building her up to be a major character.<ref name="Starlog" />
